floors.rationale: 13 modules, avg 6+ files per module. Prevents single-file monolith.
Functions, classes, components, hooks, middleware across modules.
Users, workspaces, memberships, requests, comments, audit_log, notifications, jobs, settings + join tables.
CRUD per module + auth + reporting + import/export.
Login, dashboard, requests list/detail/create, settings, reports, admin panel.
Loading/empty/error/success per view + API error handling.

antiInflation: No empty files count toward sourceFiles
No re-exports count as unique exports
Cross-module deps must be declared in spec
Exports must be referenced in at least one other module or test
